title: ID0368711-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / N4 160342494] DC contactors are not switching
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC contactors are not switching. Switching signal is not arriving to the contactors. Status monitoring device (EcoG) is providing 7V on TrC terminal during standby mode. After session start TrO terminal is not providing 24V to the contactors to close.
Root cause: Ecog faulty
Solution: Replaced Ecog
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status: Not in warranty
